query_baseline.query: 开源情报（OSINT）是收集、分析和传播公开来源信息以满足特定情报需求的做法。确保开源信息可靠性的最有效方法是什么？

bge.knowledge_zh: 开源情报（OSINT）是从公开来源收集和分析信息
bge.knowledge_en: Definition of OSINT
bge.en_quote: Open-source intelligence (OSINT) is the collection and analysis of information from publicly available sources.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: OSINT仅依赖公开可访问的信息，不包括专有或内部数据
bge.knowledge_en: OSINT definition: publicly accessible information only
bge.en_quote: Importantly, OSINT relies only on information that is publicly accessible. It excludes any proprietary, confidential, or internal data and focuses solely on open sources—content that anyone can access without special credentials.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: 分析师必须确认OSINT信息来源的可靠性才能依赖
bge.knowledge_en: Analysts must confirm OSINT source reliability
bge.en_quote: OSINT draws information from sources that may be unreliable, so analysts should confirm the source of information to be able to rely on it.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: OSINT利用公开信息评估声誉风险、检测红旗信号信号并构建更全面的客户画像
bge.knowledge_en: OSINT definition and benefits
bge.en_quote: By leveraging publicly available information, organizations can assess reputational risks, detect potential red flags, and build more comprehensive client profiles—all while staying within legal and ethical boundaries. OSINT harnesses the vast amount of data available online to supplement traditional internal sources of information.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: 开展开源研究，包括社交媒体、新闻、公共记录及监管机构发布的警报和指引
bge.knowledge_en: Conducting open-source research to include social media, news articles, public records and notices, alerts, or guidance issued by law enforcement and regulatory agencies, to inform their opinion on the escalated activity
bge.en_quote: Conducting open-source research to include social media, news articles, public records and notices, alerts, or guidance issued by law enforcement and regulatory agencies, to inform their opinion on the escalated activity.

bge.knowledge_zh: OSINT可在不违反隐私法的情况下增强风险评估和调查能力
bge.knowledge_en: Benefits of OSINT for risk assessment and compliance
bge.en_quote: Since OSINT involves analyzing data already in the public domain, it allows organizations to enhance their risk assessments and investigative capabilities without violating privacy laws.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: 搜索引擎是最常用OSINT工具，可发现新闻、监管通知、社交媒体和存档网站
bge.knowledge_en: Search engine as OSINT tool
bge.en_quote: The most obvious and widely used tool is the search engine, which serves as the entry point to uncovering vast amounts of publicly available data. Search engines can find news articles, regulatory notices, social media activity, and archived websites that provide valuable context about individuals or organizations.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bge.knowledge_zh: OSINT来源包括社交媒体、公司网站、政府数据库、新闻稿和在线新闻
bge.knowledge_en: Examples of OSINT sources
bge.en_quote: These sources can include social media platforms, corporate websites, government databases, press releases, and online news outlets.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

bm25_en.en_quote: Importantly, OSINT relies only on information that is publicly accessible. It excludes any proprietary, confidential, or internal data and focuses solely on open sources—content that anyone can access without special credentials.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: 开源情报（OSINT）是从公开来源收集和分析信息
merged_units.en_quote: Open-source intelligence (OSINT) is the collection and analysis of information from publicly available sources.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: 现有多种OSINT工具和技术，从基础到高度复杂
merged_units.en_quote: Numerous OSINT tools and techniques are available today, ranging from basic to highly sophisticated.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: OSINT长期以来是执法、政府机构和金融机构的重要工具
merged_units.en_quote: OSINT has long been a vital tool for sectors such as law enforcement, government agencies, and financial institutions.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: 负责任使用OSINT有助于更明智决策并加强透明度、问责和合规
merged_units.knowledge_en: Responsible OSINT use improves decision-making and compliance
merged_units.en_quote: When used responsibly, OSINT empowers organizations to make more-informed decisions while reinforcing transparency, accountability, and regulatory compliance.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_en: OSINT definition: publicly accessible information only
merged_units.en_quote: Importantly, OSINT relies only on information that is publicly accessible. It excludes any proprietary, confidential, or internal data and focuses solely on open sources—content that anyone can access without special credentials.

merged_units.knowledge_zh: 分析师必须确认OSINT信息来源的可靠性才能依赖
merged_units.knowledge_en: Analysts must confirm OSINT source reliability
merged_units.en_quote: OSINT draws information from sources that may be unreliable, so analysts should confirm the source of information to be able to rely on it.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: OSINT技术近期在商业领域流行，用于加强尽职调查和了解你的客户实践
merged_units.en_quote: Recently, OSINT techniques have gained popularity in the broader commercial space, particularly as companies seek to strengthen their due diligence and KYC practices.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: OSINT可在不违反隐私法的情况下增强风险评估和调查能力
merged_units.knowledge_en: Benefits of OSINT for risk assessment and compliance
merged_units.en_quote: Since OSINT involves analyzing data already in the public domain, it allows organizations to enhance their risk assessments and investigative capabilities without violating privacy laws.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: OSINT利用公开信息评估声誉风险、检测红旗信号信号并构建更全面的客户画像
merged_units.en_quote: By leveraging publicly available information, organizations can assess reputational risks, detect potential red flags, and build more comprehensive client profiles—all while staying within legal and ethical boundaries. OSINT harnesses the vast amount of data available online to supplement traditional internal sources of information.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

merged_units.knowledge_zh: OSINT来源包括社交媒体、公司网站、政府数据库、新闻稿和在线新闻
merged_units.en_quote: These sources can include social media platforms, corporate websites, government databases, press releases, and online news outlets.
heading_context: Technology and tools used across the customer life cycle

heading_context: Roles of regulators, law enforcement, and FIUs
